name: Letterboxd Diary
author: Thunderhat
description: Mark the films in your Letterboxd diary as watched in Plex. Import your export ZIP once, then optionally keep up with new diary entries from your RSS feed.

settingsSchema.label: Movie libraries
settingsSchema.help: No libraries are selected by default. Only films in these movie libraries are marked watched.

settingsSchema.label: Letterboxd username
settingsSchema.help: Public username. Only needed for catch-up from your diary RSS feed.

settingsSchema.label: Catch up from RSS
settingsSchema.help: Check your Letterboxd RSS feed on a schedule and mark new diary entries watched. The feed only holds recent entries, so import the export ZIP for older ones.
